shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在电工实验台前，台上整齐摆着电表和导线，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an electrical lab bench with neatly arranged analog meters and coiled wires, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到电工基础实验课！
overlay: 电工基础实验：课程导览

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 电表、导线、灯泡、闪电警示标志四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an analog meter with a blank dial, a coil of wire, a light bulb, and an electrical hazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 今天先看看这门课要学什么。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进电工实验室，好奇地伸手去摸台上的接线柱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into an electrical lab for the first time and curiously reaches toward the terminals on a bench panel.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进电工实验室，啥都想摸。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向墙上的电源总闸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points to the main power switch box on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先弄清哪里有电。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这门课，先认设备，再学安全，后动手。

shots.section_title: 课程目标：认识常用电气设备
shots.scene: 王老师站在实验室讲台前，身后是家用配电箱和工厂电机的图片
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at the front of an electrical lab; behind him are simple pictures of a home distribution box and a factory motor.
shots.narration: 这门课介绍家里和工厂常用的电气设备。
overlay: 课程目标：认识常用电气设备

shots.section_title: 课程目标：认识常用电气设备
shots.scene: 一本空白理论教材和一块实验板用箭头连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A blank textbook icon and a lab circuit board icon connected by a two-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 动手做一做，理论课也更好懂。

shots.section_title: 先认识设备，再动手做实验
shots.scene: 欣欣指着排成两步的图标：先是工具箱，后是电路板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two steps shown as icons: first a toolbox with meters, then a circuit board with a check mark.
shots.narration: 先一件件认识设备，再一个个做实验。
overlay: 先认识设备，再动手做实验

shots.section_title: 实验一：验证基尔霍夫定律
shots.scene: 一个简单直流电路图标，节点处有几个箭头汇合
shots.prompt_en: A simple DC circuit icon with a battery and resistors, arrows meeting at one junction. No people.
shots.narration: 实验一：验证基尔霍夫电流和电压定律。
overlay: 实验一：验证基尔霍夫定律

shots.section_title: 实验一：验证基尔霍夫定律
shots.scene: 小研先在空白纸上计算，再看电表读数比对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student first calculates on a blank sheet of paper, then compares her result with a meter reading on the bench.
shots.narration: 先算理论值，再用实测来验证。

shots.section_title: 实验二：各类灯具的功率与功率因数
shots.scene: 白炽灯、荧光灯管、LED 灯三个图标并排，各配一个电表
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: an incandescent bulb, a fluorescent tube and an LED bulb, each with a small blank meter below. No people.
shots.narration: 实验二：测各种灯的电流和功率。
overlay: 实验二：各类灯具的功率与功率因数

shots.section_title: 实验二：各类灯具的功率与功率因数
shots.scene: 三个灯泡下方的柱形高低不同
shots.prompt_en: Three lamp icons with bars of different heights beneath them, showing different energy use. No people.
shots.narration: 比一比，谁最费电、谁最省电。

shots.section_title: 实验二：各类灯具的功率与功率因数
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个写着问号的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 还要弄懂什么是功率因数。

shots.section_title: 实验三：三电压表法测线圈参数
shots.scene: 一个线圈图标连着三个电压表图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an iron-core coil connected with three small voltmeter icons. No people.
shots.narration: 实验三：三个电压表，算出线圈的电阻和电感。
overlay: 实验三：三电压表法测线圈参数

shots.section_title: 实验四：星形与三角形连接
shots.scene: 星形和三角形两种连接图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: three loads connected in a star shape and three loads connected in a triangle shape. No people.
shots.narration: 实验四：三相负载的星形和三角形接法。
overlay: 实验四：星形与三角形连接

shots.section_title: 实验四：星形与三角形连接
shots.scene: 老周指着两种接法图标讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the star and triangle connection icons on a board and explains.
shots.narration: 实测线电压、相电压，线电流、相电流的关系。

shots.section_title: 实验五：二瓦特表法测三相功率
shots.scene: 两个功率表图标接在三相线路上
shots.prompt_en: Two wattmeter icons with blank dials connected to a three-line power circuit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验五：用两只功率表测三相功率。
overlay: 实验五：二瓦特表法测三相功率

shots.section_title: 实验五：二瓦特表法测三相功率
shots.scene: 平衡的天平和不平衡的天平两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a balanced scale and an unbalanced scale, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 负载对称不对称，这个方法都能用。

shots.section_title: 实验六：双控与多地控制照明
shots.scene: 楼梯上下各有一个开关，控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a wall switch at the bottom and another at the top, both controlling one ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 实验六：楼上楼下两个开关控一盏灯。
overlay: 实验六：双控与多地控制照明

shots.section_title: 实验六：双控与多地控制照明
shots.scene: 长走廊或仓库里三个开关控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A long corridor icon with three wall switches along it, all linked to one ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 长走廊、大仓库，多处都能开关同一盏灯。

shots.section_title: 实验六：双控与多地控制照明
shots.scene: 一张空白表格，格子里只有亮灯和灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table grid with only lamp-on and lamp-off icons in its cells. No people.
shots.narration: 还要把开关状态列成真值表。

shots.section_title: 实验七：测量接地电阻
shots.scene: 接地极插入土地，旁边一个测量仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal earth rod driven into the ground with a cable to a blank test instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 实验七：测量接地电阻。
overlay: 实验七：测量接地电阻

shots.section_title: 实验七：测量接地电阻
shots.scene: 电器外壳通过导线接地，故障电流流入大地
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an appliance casing with a green-yellow earth wire leading into the ground, an arrow showing fault current flowing to earth. No people.
shots.narration: 弄懂为什么要接地，接地电阻怎样降低。

shots.section_title: 实验八：开路与短路
shots.scene: 一个断开的电路和一个被导线短接的电路图标
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: one with an open gap in the wire, one with a wire bridging across the load. No people.
shots.narration: 实验八：交流电路开路和短路会怎样。
overlay: 实验八：开路与短路

shots.section_title: 目标一：认识元件、导线和仪表
shots.scene: 电阻、电容、电感三个元件图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a resistor, a capacitor and an inductor coil lined up on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 目标一：认识电阻、电容、电感。
overlay: 目标一：认识元件、导线和仪表

shots.section_title: 目标一：认识元件、导线和仪表
shots.scene: 不同颜色、粗细的导线卷
shots.prompt_en: Coils of wire in different colors and thicknesses on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 认识各种导线和测量仪表。

shots.section_title: 目标一：认识元件、导线和仪表
shots.scene: 交流波形和直流直线两个图标，各连一个电表
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a sine wave and a straight line, each linked to a blank meter. No people.
shots.narration: 学会交流、直流怎么测，表怎么接。

shots.section_title: 目标二：功率、功率因数与阻抗
shots.scene: 灯泡和三相电机图标旁各有一个功率表
shots.prompt_en: A lamp icon and a three-phase motor icon, each with a blank wattmeter beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 目标二：测灯具和三相电路的功率。
overlay: 目标二：功率、功率因数与阻抗

shots.section_title: 目标二：功率、功率因数与阻抗
shots.scene: 电阻加线圈、电阻加电容两个小电路图标
shots.prompt_en: Two small circuit icons: a resistor with a coil, and a resistor with a capacitor. No people.
shots.narration: 再学会测量阻抗。

shots.section_title: 目标三：接地电阻与多地控灯
shots.scene: 接地极图标和多开关控灯图标并排
shots.prompt_en: An earth rod icon next to an icon of one lamp controlled by switches in different places. No people.
shots.narration: 目标三：测接地电阻，学多地控灯。
overlay: 目标三：接地电阻与多地控灯

shots.section_title: 导论课要认识的器材
shots.scene: 欣欣站在器材柜前，柜里有电表、电源、示波器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an open equipment cabinet holding analog meters, a regulated power supply and an oscilloscope with blank screen.
shots.narration: 导论课要认识一批器材。
overlay: 导论课要认识的器材

shots.section_title: 导论课要认识的器材
shots.scene: 变阻器、二极管、晶体管、导线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sliding rheostat, a diode, a transistor and a coil of wire. No people.
shots.narration: 元件：变阻器、二极管、晶体管、导线。

shots.section_title: 导论课要认识的器材
shots.scene: 电压表、电流表、功率表、万用表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a voltmeter, an ammeter, a wattmeter and a multimeter, all with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 仪表：电压表、电流表、功率表、万用表。

shots.section_title: 导论课要认识的器材
shots.scene: 稳压电源、信号发生器、示波器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a regulated DC power supply, a function generator and an oscilloscope, all with blank panels. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器：稳压电源、信号源、示波器。

shots.section_title: 导论课要认识的器材
shots.scene: 变压器、直流电动机、发电机、三相电动机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a transformer, a DC motor, a generator and a three-phase induction motor. No people.
shots.narration: 还有变压器和各种电机。

shots.section_title: 用电安全，人人要懂
shots.scene: 欣欣举着闪电警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an electrical hazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 做实验之前，先学用电安全。
overlay: 用电安全，人人要懂

shots.section_title: 用电安全，人人要懂
shots.scene: 阿杰回家给家人讲插座安全，家人点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student at home explains socket safety to the older man, pointing at a wall socket; the older man nods.
shots.narration: 学会了，也给身边的人讲一讲。

shots.section_title: 有疑问及时提出
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，王老师微笑回应
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question, and the safety administrator smiles and answers.
shots.narration: 有不懂的，随时提问。
overlay: 有疑问及时提出

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 王老师给新生上安全课，屏幕空白只有闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a safety class to new students in front of a screen showing only an electrical hazard icon.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先参加安全培训。
overlay: 先培训考核，再进实验室

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 一张空白证书上盖了绿色对勾章
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate with a green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 考核合格，才能进来做实验。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 小研在门口的空白登记本上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank logbook at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 进出登记，听从指导教师安排。

shots.section_title: 进实验室前的着装与准备
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、平底鞋，长发扎起，双手干燥
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat and closed flat shoes, her long hair tied back, showing dry hands.
shots.narration: 穿好实验服和不露脚的鞋，长发扎起。
overlay: 进实验室前的着装与准备

shots.section_title: 进实验室前的着装与准备
shots.scene: 戒指、手链、手表图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a metal ring, a metal bracelet and a metal watch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下金属饰品，手要擦干。

shots.section_title: 进实验室前的着装与准备
shots.scene: 台面上水杯和饮料被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A water cup and a drink bottle on an electrical bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验台上不放水杯饮料。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰先拉下实验台电源开关，再动手接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student first switches off the bench power switch, then starts connecting wires on the panel.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。
overlay: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师对照电路图逐根检查导线
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks each connecting wire against a blank circuit diagram on the bench.
shots.narration: 接好后，请指导教师检查线路。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头，阿杰才合上电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator nods approval, and only then does the young male student switch on the bench power.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能合闸通电。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰拉下开关后才去改线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power before moving a wire.
shots.narration: 要改线？先断电，改完再请老师查。

shots.section_title: 不带电作业，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 手伸向通电接线柱的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand reaching toward live terminals with a lightning symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不带电接线，不用手碰带电部分。
overlay: 不带电作业，不私拉乱接

shots.section_title: 不带电作业，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 插线板串接插线板的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip plugged into another power strip with tangled cords, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线，不乱接插线板。

shots.section_title: 不带电作业，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 破皮导线图标被红叉划掉，旁边是完好的导线打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a wire with cracked insulation crossed out with a red X, and an intact wire with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 导线破损、仪器异常，停用并报告。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电
shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲向墙上总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside a bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to the main power switch on the wall.
shots.narration: 有人触电，第一步：立刻切断电源。
overlay: 触电急救：先断电

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电
shots.scene: 徒手拉触电者的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a person being shocked, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 断电前，绝不能徒手去拉触电的人。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电
shots.scene: 老周拨打电话，手机屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen, looking urgent.
shots.narration: 断电后，立即拨打 120 求救。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电
shots.scene: 受过培训的老李在旁照护伤者
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, trained in first aid, kneels to check on the young male student, who now lies on the floor away from the bench.
shots.narration: 受过培训的人，按规范进行急救。

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 实验台冒烟，老李先拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: Smoke rises from a bench; the facility engineer pulls down the main power switch first.
shots.narration: 电气起火，先切断电源。
overlay: 电气起火：先断电再灭火

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 向冒烟电器泼水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bucket of water thrown onto a smoking appliance, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，不能用水浇。

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 老李用二氧化碳灭火器对准火根
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer aims a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher at the base of a small fire on the bench.
shots.narration: 用干粉或二氧化碳灭火器扑救。

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 火势变大，大家沿疏散路线撤离，有人打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; students leave along an evacuation route marked by an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，撤离并拨打 119。

shots.section_title: 出了事故要报告
shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员在一旁记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer takes notes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 事后报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。
overlay: 出了事故要报告

shots.section_title: 出了事故要报告
shots.scene: 王老师和老李查看烧坏的设备并在空白表格上记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer inspect a damaged instrument and fill in a blank report form.
shots.narration: 如实记录，查找原因，防止再犯。

shots.section_title: 小结
